name: Editorial reference
typography: A bold sans serif title at 60px; 28px body; short labels at 18px. Use a CJK sans fallback, never infer an exact font from pixels.
composition: Use 64px outer margins, asymmetric 60/40 cover, aligned columns for comparison and a wide ordered path for process. One dominant headline per page.
shapes: A single bright capsule frames the core benefit. Flat rules separate comparable criteria. Small circles mark steps; no unrelated decorations.
avoid: No original photos, logos, copy or artwork. Avoid repeated empty cards and tiny body text.

layouts.cover: Place a bold two-line title on the left and an oversized benefit capsule on the right, with generous negative space.
layouts.comparison: Two clearly named options share aligned criterion rows. Highlight only the recommended direction in a tinted column, keeping label baselines aligned.
layouts.process: Arrange three numbered actions along a horizontal connector. Keep action and result adjacent and add one shared outcome at the bottom.
